Opening a recording no longer starts the analysis over, and ending a meeting goes straight to its report.

**Analysis runs once per recording.** Opening a recording you had already looked at, especially one recorded on the phone, used to start the analysis again.

- **Leaving early keeps the work.** A pass that finishes after you have moved to another recording is saved to the one it was running for. Coming back while it is still running picks it up instead of starting a second one.
- **The meeting type is remembered**, so it is no longer re-detected on every open.
- **An empty brief is reported as a failure** you can regenerate, instead of being treated as missing and generated again on every open.

**Ending a meeting**

- **The window changes layout once.** After End, the coach keeps its three columns until the report opens, instead of squeezing in the sidebar for the whole save. ⌘B still shows the sidebar during a long save.
- **The report opens as soon as the recording is written.** Speaker correction runs in the background, and the analysis waits for it, so it reads the corrected speakers the first time.

**Reading a recording**

- **Sections load as placeholders shaped like their content**, so the page no longer jumps when the brief, action items, delivery or findings arrive.
- **The titlebar shows where the recording lives**, as `folder › name`. Clicking the folder takes you back to it, replacing the close-recording button.

**Cloud sync**

- **Recordings deleted on another device stay deleted.** They used to be uploaded again, audio included, every couple of minutes. A recording synced from this computer is now removed here too; one that never reached the cloud is kept.
- Recordings inside a folder list newest first.
